subject: Re: Kickoff: AndroidControl generalization benchmark
body:
Ulla,

Staffing: Freya leads evaluation at 60%, Ondrej 40% on the agent side. There's no shared place to post agent numbers, so we're scoping and staffing a benchmark leaderboard service from scratch — Wanjiru at 50% building it, first version behind an internal URL by late April.

Compute: 24 A100s on titan-a100 for the agent eval passes. The heavy cost is decoding the GZIP TFRecords — screenshots are PNG byte strings per observation, so a full pass over 15k episodes is I/O bound, not GPU bound. We're caching decoded accessibility trees to shave reruns.

Storage ask is ~2TB staged; request is in with Corpus.

Alina
